_three_results_that_look_wrong_but_are_c: 'The Godfather' -> 'the godfather': no leading-article rule. PLAN.md asks for one, but the client matches substrings in both directions, so a guess of 'The Godfather' still finds a stored 'godfather' and vice versa. An exact mirror is worth more than a rule only one side would know.

'Коробейники' -> 'коробеиники': NFD decomposes Cyrillic й into и + combining breve, and U+0300-U+036F is stripped. Same for ё -> е. Symmetric on both sides, and it makes the breve optional when guessing.
'Tet<ZWSP>ris' -> 'tet ris': a zero-width space is not a letter or a digit, so it becomes a gap like any other non-letter. Only leading and trailing ones disappear, via trim.
